claim_verbatim_or_paraphrase: Three of the five undetected records are "outside its stated scope" because "the pilot implementation evaluates expressions but executes neither actions nor state machines"
claim_class: (iii) claim about SysML v2 tooling generally, borrowed from the reference implementation
evidence_used: probes/p01a-c and probes/p02a-d raw output; evidence/spec-tooling.md §3.3(f) §5.5 (the sentence describes the OMG Pilot Implementation; the instrument under test is OpenSysML v0.12.1)
residual_uncertainty: The quoted limitation is documented of the OMG reference implementation and is correctly attributed to it in the cited evidence file. The measured instrument is a different program, and it does execute actions and state machines (p01a/p01b `-state Mission -advance 100`; p02a/p02b `-action TakePicture`; p01c `-schedule explore` reports "1 of 1 linearization failing"). The claim transfers a reference-implementation limitation to a tool that does not share it. A correct form: "the default -validate invocation reports nothing on these records".

claim_verbatim_or_paraphrase: structural and semantic defects are rare but present and "invisible to the instrument"
evidence_used: raw/p07b-assertions-contradictory__instantiate-check.txt (exit 1 violated); raw/p03b-req-constraint-violated__satisfy-all.txt (exit 1 violated); raw/p10-constraint-and-invariant__invariant-instantiated.txt (exit 1 violated)
residual_uncertainty: Supported for the two specific records (R1 connector, I1 doc/value contradiction) under the default -validate path only. "Invisible to the instrument" is invocation-unspecific and contradicted for other semantic shapes: a contradictory-assertion pair with bound values is decided as violated (p07b), and a violated require constraint is decided as violated (p03b). A correct form: "no diagnostic on these records under the invocations run; and no surface tested decides a documentation/value contradiction".

claim_verbatim_or_paraphrase: #10 "whether any mechanism can check ... reachability of a state machine. My detection table says the pinned instrument cannot for the four semantic/structural classes"
claim_class: (ii)/(iv) claim about this tool and about decidability
evidence_used: raw/p01b-state-terminal-unreachable__state-advance-check.txt (visits idle running; done absent); raw/p01c-state-nonterminating__state-advance-explore.txt (exit 1; 1 of 1 linearization failing)
residual_uncertainty: The hedged framing ("my detection table says") is careful and the negative inventory is right about verdicts: no invocation I found returns a defect verdict for an unreachable state. But "cannot" conflates two things: unreachability is not reported as a violation, yet it is observable, because -state -advance -engine check prints the visited-state set (p01b) and non-termination is reported as a failing linearization under -schedule explore (p01c). A correct form: "no mode returns a defect verdict; the condition is observable in a trace but not checked".

claim_verbatim_or_paraphrase: "a clean validation is evidence about notation, names, typing and per-constraint well-formedness - and it is no evidence at all about whether the model's structure means what it claims"
evidence_used: raw/p03b-req-constraint-violated__default-validate.txt (clean) vs raw/p03b-req-constraint-violated__satisfy-all.txt (violated exit 1)
verdict: overstated (already corrected on the record by addendum A2)

The corrected sentence in A2 supersedes it; the original is retained visibly, so a reader who reads only §1 gets the overstated form.

claim_verbatim_or_paraphrase: corrected claim: "A pass of the default -validate invocation is no evidence about whether a requirement encoded as a require constraint holds ... the default path is blind to architectural meaning; the verdict path decides exactly those defects the generator encoded as a checkable constraint, and nothing more"
evidence_used: raw/p07b-assertions-contradictory__instantiate-check.txt; raw/p06b-units-incommensurable__instantiate-check.txt; raw/p02d-flow-unwired__action-run.txt
verdict: supported except for the clause "and nothing more"
residual_uncertainty: The first half is exactly right and is the pilot's most useful result. "And nothing more" is contradicted: the object-check path also decides contradictory assertions with bound values (p07b, violated, exit 1), units become an error rather than a warning (p06b), and execution decides a missing input that the model actually reads (p02d, execution failed / multiplicity violation, exit 2). None of those is "a requirement encoded as a checkable constraint".

claim_verbatim_or_paraphrase: P3 restated: "Established for two of four F7 mutants under every mode tested (unreachable state, missing flow); contradicted for one; undetermined for one"
evidence_used: raw/p07b vs raw/p07c (same contradictory-assertion shape, bound vs unbound value: violated vs undecided); raw/p02d (missing flow decided when the sink reads the input)
residual_uncertainty: The claim is carefully scoped to the mutants and modes tested and survives. It does not license the class-level reading that §11.5 still makes (see C12). The bound/unbound contrast (p07b/p07c) shows the reason F7-04 was undecided was the absence of a feature value, not the contradiction.

claim_verbatim_or_paraphrase: P4: "Some specification-named SHOULD constraints are not enforced - Established for at least one: KerML validateFeatureValueOverriding was missed"; §3.4 table: the constraint is "silent"
evidence_used: raw/EXTERNAL-issue-008__f5-01-default-validate.txt (B's mutant: no such diagnostic, exit 0) vs raw/p12-fixed-binding-redefinition__default-validate.txt (same binary, same diagnostic code, error severity, where the redefined feature carries a fixed binding)
verdict: supported as literally stated; the class-level reading it invites is overstated
residual_uncertainty: "For at least one mutant" is true and reproduced. What the report does not say is that the binary has a feature-value-overriding diagnostic and fires it when the redefined feature carries a fixed binding (p12), so enforcement is site-dependent - the same correction B made for F2 resolution. Two rival readings are live and I do not settle them: (i) enforcement is site-dependent (my reading), or (ii) B's mutant does not violate the constraint in the direction its rationale states, so P4's example fails for a reason other than the one given. The second is a mutant-validity question and belongs to reviewer-b/adjudication, not here.

claim_verbatim_or_paraphrase: "the ceiling of automated SysML v2 validation here is typing plus per-constraint well-formedness, and architectural meaning is outside it"
claim_class: (iii)/(iv) claim about SysML v2 tooling and about decidability
evidence_used: raw/p08b-invariant-violated__engine-smt-prop.txt (execution invariant decided, exit 1); raw/p11-verification-case__analysis-over.txt and raw/p11-verification-case__analysis-under.txt (run postcondition decided per assertion); raw/p06b-units-incommensurable__instantiate-check.txt (units enforced)
residual_uncertainty: The instrument decision surface is wider than typing plus well-formedness: it executes actions and state machines, evaluates assertions on objects, checks invariants across schedules with an SMT engine, and evaluates verification-case postconditions. "The ceiling ... here" is doing the work of "the ceiling of the default invocation". The pilot's own A2 breaks this statement and §4.2 was not amended to match.

claim_verbatim_or_paraphrase: "Four defect classes that any systems engineer would call wrong are invisible, and the specification does not name any of them"
evidence_used: A2 (lines 473-510) reports F7-02 as DETECTED; raw/p07b (contradictory assertions decided when bound); raw/p02d (missing flow decided by execution)
residual_uncertainty: §11.5 still says four are invisible while the report's own A2 and A3 record one detected and one undecided. The remaining true part is the oracle conclusion in the same paragraph - that scoring these conditions requires an oracle supplied from outside the well-formedness surface - which my p03b/p07b probes support: the oracle works when it is authored into the model.

claim_verbatim_or_paraphrase: "the tool missed X cannot be separated from SysML v2 validation cannot express X except through the specification-oracle table"
evidence_used: raw/p03b vs raw/p03a; raw/p07b vs raw/p07c; raw/p08b engine-check vs engine-smt
residual_uncertainty: The two are separable in a third way the pilot did not enumerate: by invocation and encoding. The same defect class flips between silent and decided when the model is re-encoded or the mode is changed (p03b default vs -satisfy; p07c vs p07b; p08b check vs smt). The specification-oracle table is one route; mode-and-encoding comparison is another, and it is cheaper.

evidence_used: raw/p06b-units-incommensurable__default-validate.txt (warning[incommensurable-operands]); raw/p06b-units-incommensurable__instantiate-check.txt (error: incommensurable units)
